title: MACHINE WRECKS
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of every character and machine, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. Every machine that died left the same flat turning oval: a Sentry, a Crawler and a Warden all died as the same blob. Now a dead machine leaves its own body for the moment of its death: its eye goes black, it darkens, sinks a little into the ground and tips over, then fades out over the oval and the burst it always left. A Crier drops out of the air. Nothing about play changes.
now: A destroyed machine leaves its own dark, tipped-over wreck as it dies, not just an oval.
